package.description: Explorer thumbnails for 366 file types Windows can't read, plus a right-click image toolkit.

en-US.description: Explorer thumbnails for 366 file types Windows can't read, plus a right-click image toolkit.
en-US.longDescription: SageThumbs 2K is a modern, crash-isolated Windows 11 shell extension written in Rust that rebuilds the classic SageThumbs. It gives File Explorer thumbnails for 366 file types Windows can't preview on its own — camera RAW, HEIC/AVIF, Photoshop, DjVu, ebooks and comics, video frames, 3D-print files and a long tail of obscure formats — plus a right-click image toolkit (convert, resize, rotate, OCR, color picker, metadata strip, combine-to-PDF/CBZ) and a console/AI CLI. Free for personal use.
en-US.name: SageThumbs 2K
en-US.releaseNotes:
## TL;DR **≡ƒåò New** - **Files with no picture of their own can get a format tile (#82)** - **A video's thumbnail can show its resolution (#80)** - **Settings warns about mismatched file types and skipped import values** - **Recent uploads gain a Delete from host button** **≡ƒöü Changed** - **The folder.ico icon settings moved to the Ebook/comic page** - **Imported settings reach your other PCs straight away** - **Importing settings no longer changes upload hosts, network folders or remote-content switches** - **Settings sync merges each setting separately and keeps some local** - **Feedback form says the app version and Windows build go with it** - **HTML previews open links only on click and web images load per document** - **Crashing files are skipped for 2 minutes; locked files retry at once** - **Context menu preview picture comes from Windows' own cache** - **Pixelate blurs each block evenly** - **`st2k batch` numbers a clashing name "(2)", as Explorer does** - **Combine to PDF/CBZ and Sort by dimensions read pictures outside Explorer** - **Disconnect signs this PC out at the sign-in server, not just on this PC** **≡ƒ⌐╣ Fixed** - **Resolume DXV clips in the high-quality modes get a thumbnail (fixes #81)** - **Portrait photos from Canon CR3, Fuji RAF, Nikon NRW, Samsung SRW and Sony SR2/SRF raws are upright** - **Import Settings accepts UTF-8 files and never deletes settings on failure** - **Explorer shows badge, checkerboard and folder changes straight away** - **Settings fixes: folder icon rules, search and OCR language** - **Portable copies keep their settings and no longer affect other users** - **Sign-in and sign-out are more reliable** - **Update checks and installs no longer clash, freeze or stall** - **Rename and Files to folder dialogs behave correctly** - **Prebuild retries, cloud files and summaries behave correctly** - **Viewers stay responsive with huge GIFs, PDF zoom and printing** - **Cloud folder thumbnails keep correct badges and sync behavior** - **Transparent EXR, PSD and video thumbnails are no longer invisible** - **Explorer stays up and no longer restarts unexpectedly** - **A damaged file can no longer close Explorer through the Details pane** - **Preview pane stays responsive when dialogs close or decodes run slow** - **Uninstall removes right-click and icon changes for every user** - **Setup works for each user, including laptops on battery** - **Setup keeps custom install folders and system file-type icons safe** - **Screenshot command line never deletes files it did not create** - **Screenshot tool keeps captures, cleans temp files and redo works** - **Screenshot editor and uploads report results accurately** - **Uploads of unusual files finish intact and never send twice** - **Markdown, video and text previews render correctly** - **SQLite and syntax highlighting previews respect work limits** - **iPhone HEVC videos get thumbnails again** - **Canon EOS R6 Mark III raws no longer turn magenta in full-size views** - **Strip metadata never loses your original file** - **Damaged or hostile image files can no longer exhaust memory or hang a decode** - **Preview pane gives up on a stalled cloud or network file instead of hanging** - **Convert, resize, email and compress never write over another file** - **Right-click file commands: case-only rename, folder icons, failure lists and compress counts** - **Text reading (OCR) reads rotated phone photos upright** - **3D models, EXR, JPEG 2000 and other previews draw correctly on unusual files** - **A short or damaged file can no longer close Explorer by reading past its end** - **Toolbar icons sit centred in their buttons**
Read more: everything in 4.1.0 - **Files with no picture of their own can get a format tile (#82).** An MP3 with no cover art, or a ZIP with no images, reads fine but has no picture, so Explorer showed the program's icon. With **Files with no picture of their own: show a format tile** on (Settings, Appearance, off by default) it gets a tile with its format written large in that format's colour. A corrupt or unreadable file still shows the icon. - **A video's thumbnail can show its resolution (#80).** With **Show the video's resolution on its thumbnail** on (Settings, Appearance, off by default) a video's thumbnail carries its display size, such as `1920├ù1080`, in the top-left corner. It is drawn only on thumbnails at least 96 pixels across their longer side, so the small Explorer sizes stay clean. - **The folder.ico icon settings moved to the Ebook/comic page.** Settings' Appearance page needed the room for the two new switches above, so **Add "Use folder.ico icons" to the folder right-click menu** and **Folder icons by nameΓÇª** now sit on the Ebook/comic page under **Folder icons**, beside the other choices about a file's cover picture. - **Resolume DXV clips in the high-quality modes get a thumbnail (#81).** DXV stores its frames in one of a few texture modes, and SageThumbs read only the two standard ones, so a clip saved in the high-quality mode (with or without transparency) showed the player's icon. Both high-quality modes are decoded now. - **Portrait photos from more camera raws are upright.** A camera that is held upright records the turn in the raw file, and SageThumbs missed it in three places: a Canon CR3 keeps it in its own metadata box, a Fuji RAF keeps it in its preview picture's data, and for a raw over 16 MB (Nikon NRW, Samsung SRW, Sony SR2 and SRF) the quick path that reads only the preview picture left it behind. Those portraits showed sideways; they are upright now. - **Settings warns about mismatched file types and skipped import values.** Windows can end up with a different set of file types than the one you chose, for example after an admin prompt was answered with another account. Settings now warns you when that happens. After Import Settings, Settings also lists the values it left unchanged because they could send data off this PC. - **Recent uploads gain a Delete from host button.** Until now, Recent uploads had no button to remove a mistaken upload. The new Delete from host button removes it from hosts that support deletion. - **Imported settings reach your other PCs straight away.** Imported settings did not reach your other PCs straight away before. Now they are sent to them as soon as you import the file. - **Importing settings no longer changes upload hosts, network folders or remote-content switches.** Before, importing a settings file could change the upload host, the licence mode, the network save folders and the remote-content switches. Now an import leaves those alone. - **Settings sync merges each setting separately and keeps some local.** Before, a change on one PC could be reverted by another. Now each setting merges on its own, so a change on one PC stays. The Prebuild folder verb setting and the legacy badge setting no longer sync between PCs, and network switches that arrive by sync can only be fully on or off. - **Feedback form says the app version and Windows build go with it.** Before, the feedback form did not say which app version and Windows build went with your message. It now says so on the form. - **HTML previews open links only on click and web images load per document.** Now an HTML preview opens a link in your browser only when you click it. The Load web images setting in the preview pane applies only to the current document. HTML files on a network share show as plain source text. - **Crashing files are skipped for 2 minutes; locked files retry at once.** Before, a file that crashed or hung the thumbnail host was retried by every new host, and a locked or still-downloading file showed an icon for 2 minutes. Now a file that crashes or hangs is skipped for 2 minutes, and a locked or still-downloading file is tried again at once. - **Context menu preview picture comes from Windows' own cache.** The preview in the right-click menu no longer decodes big pictures inside Explorer. It skips pictures over 64 megapixels and takes the picture from Windows' own thumbnail cache. - **Pixelate blurs each block evenly.** In the screenshot tool, Pixelate used to keep one exact pixel from each block. Now it averages each block, so the blur looks even. - **`st2k batch` numbers a clashing name "(2)", as Explorer does.** When an output name was taken, the command line wrote `photo (1).webp`, while Convert and every other verb wrote `photo (2).webp`. It now names it the same way they do, and a folder where every name answers "taken", such as a broken network share, ends with an error instead of trying names forever. - **Combine to PDF/CBZ and Sort by dimensions read pictures outside Explorer.** Every other right-click command already read your pictures in a separate helper, so a damaged file could crash
